settings.label: MODULE 01
settings.heading: Choosing what to sell
settings.body: Read demand before you spend. Sold listings, not active ones. Seasonal traps. Whether a product gets bought twice or once. You leave with a shortlist matched to your budget.
settings.link_text: See the stock this applies to

settings.label: MODULE 02
settings.heading: The numbers that decide profit
settings.body: Unit cost, packaging, platform fees, postage, returns. We build your real break-even, set a floor you never sell under, and work out how many units make a month worth it.

settings.label: MODULE 03
settings.heading: Listings that get found and bought
settings.body: Phone photography against a wall. Titles built from words buyers actually search. Descriptions that kill objections early. How timing changes what the algorithm shows.

settings.label: MODULE 04
settings.heading: Platform strategy and staying safe
settings.body: Which products belong on Vinted, eBay, TikTok Shop or Facebook Marketplace, and why the same item performs differently on each. Plus what gets reseller accounts restricted.

settings.label: MODULE 05
settings.heading: Selling, shipping and reviews
settings.body: Replies that close the sale. Packing that arrives intact and looks considered. Dispatch speed as a ranking factor. Building the review count that makes every later listing easier.

settings.label: MODULE 06
settings.heading: Reordering and scaling
settings.body: Read your own sell-through so you reorder before you run dry. What to drop. When to widen your range against going deeper on a winner. Records that keep this a business.

settings.question: How do I get into the Skool community?
settings.answer: The invite link is in your welcome email, sent the moment your payment goes through. If it hasn't arrived in ten minutes, check spam, then message us.

settings.question: Do I have to buy stock from GBG?
settings.answer: No. Sourcing, pricing and selling are skills that apply to any supplier. Most members do order from GBG because the minimums are low and it's simple, but it isn't a condition.

settings.question: I've never sold anything online. Is this too soon?
settings.answer: Beginners do well in it. But if you haven't decided reselling is for you yet, start with SYPB and the free guides. They cost nothing and will tell you a lot.

settings.question: How much time does it take?
settings.answer: A few hours a week. Enough to work through a module and apply it to your own listings. The people who get the most out of it do the work between modules.

settings.question: Is this the same as the free community?
settings.answer: No. SYPB and the Wholesale Hub are peers, questions and alerts. The Academy is a curriculum plus direct feedback on your own work. Plenty of people use both.
